note: Exact target recovered from PROBLEM.md. Use conjugation action of G on itself. Stabilizer of x is C_G(x), so orbit size [G:C_G(x)] divides p^n and is a p-power. Singleton orbits are exactly central elements. Thus class equation modulo p gives |Z(G)| congruent to |G| congruent to 0 mod p. Since identity lies in Z(G), |Z(G)| is positive; positive divisibility by p gives |Z(G)| at least p, hence a nonidentity central element.
